hook.name: WonkHook
hook.description: Bonding-curve graduation hook for Wonk token launches. Charges a protocol swap fee and a per-launch creator tax in afterSwap as ERC-6909 hook deltas. When the pool price reaches the fundraise target, atomically burns the main liquidity band and re-pools the raised funds as a permanently locked buy-wall position (Position 3) in the same swap.
